QuestInfo.name: Poor, Lost Christopher
QuestInfo.0: Sophie has a favor to ask you. It's always something!
QuestInfo.1: Christopher the Excavator gets lost a lot. He's lost right now, in fact. He was last seen wandering around #bthe Burnt Lands west of Perion#k. Find Christopher, give him directions home, and give him some Refreshing Stump Sap for the trip back.
QuestInfo.2: You gave Refreshing Stump Sap to Christopher, and sent him off in the right direction.

0.0: I've been a little worried about Christopher the Excavator. He still hasn't arrived at the excavation site, and he left over a week ago! His sense of direction isn't the best, so he might have gotten lost in the #bBurnt Lands west of Perion#k. Please find him, get him back on track, and give him something to drink.

His sense of direction isn't the best, so he might have gotten lost in the #bBurnt Lands west of Perion#k. Please find him, get him back on track, and give him something to drink.

no.0: Sure. Talk to me again when you are ready.

1.1: This...this is #o0130100# sap!! Can I have this? Please?\r\n

yes.1: Ahhhhh! That was amazing! Oh, man! You saved my life! Okay, I better get over to the excavation site. It's north of here, right?

npc.0: You still haven't found Christopher? That's not good... He gets thirsty pretty easily...

item.0: I need...sticky sap to drink...the only drink...that satisfies completely...

lost.0: Did you lose that Refreshing Stump Sap? *Sigh* Fine, here's another. But these things aren't free! Get this one to Christopher.
